purpose: Independent tests-only review regressions for private giveaway previews; not a separately mergeable change.

commands.focused: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test giveaway_preview_review_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.combined: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test giveaway_preview_acceptance --test giveaway_preview_review_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1

contract.entrypoint: Real GiveawayRuntime::command post-authorization seam with authorized synthetic wire inputs and existing clock/nonce injection. The normal dispatcher privately defers before this seam; tests allow exactly one PATCH of the original private completion.
contract.liveEffectHeld: A real non-preview create reaches an independent bound SQL socket, proving it passed the process-wide effect lock. Retain the socket without speaking PostgreSQL. A separate runtime/pool/executor must complete a valid preview before the effect is released; assert no preview SQL, nonce or public/component effects.
contract.previewResponseHeld: Existing MockRest response gate observes the actual preview completion and withholds its HTTP response. A separate live create must reach its SQL socket before the response is released. Check the preview stayed held; release the response and abort/join held effect tasks before assertions.
contract.durationAliases: Both duration/duration-minutes orders, unequal individually valid values, preview true/false/absent: six private validation refusals, zero SQL/nonce/publication.
contract.deadlineOverflow: Construct a valid final-minute instant with time::Date::MAX.with_hms(...).assume_utc(); independently prove adding the valid one-minute duration overflows. Preview true/false/absent: three private refusals, zero SQL/nonce/publication and no panic.
contract.synchronization: Socket acceptance and the existing response gate, never sleeps. Three-second bounded observations; live SQL acquisition budget is sixty seconds. Check the held task remains unfinished before and after the observation. A test-only serial mutex prevents these four scenarios from interfering under CI default libtest parallelism; it never replaces the real runtime effect lock.
contract.cleanup: Abort and join spawned tasks, drop held SQL sockets/listeners, close pools and shut down mock REST before expected RED assertions. JoinSet, sockets and MockRest also provide panic-path cancellation/drop.
contract.registration: New non-ignored Cargo integration target is automatically discovered with --features db. No source hooks, workflow changes or live database are required. Existing CI workspace integration execution includes the target.

red.reason: Preview waits for the live-effect lock despite requiring no effects. Fixture-startup failures have separate diagnostics and are not behavioral RED.
A stalled private preview completion retains the live-effect lock and prevents a separate live create from reaching SQL.

expectedBaseline.observed: Not executed: bounded Cargo pool refused admission with exit 75 (no idle, below-budget slot; no per-worktree fallback). This is neither behavioral RED nor GREEN, and compilation remains unverified.

handoff.nextAction: Consume the immutable commit unchanged. First execute the focused target on this exact baseline plus tests to obtain behavioral RED/GREEN evidence, then implement the lock fix and run the combined target and normal CI/review gates.
handoff.ownership: Implementation owner consumes these tests unchanged and owns combined GREEN, CI, independent review and auto-merge. Return oracle defects to the test author; never weaken protected assertions.
handoff.undo: Discard this tests-only commit before consuming it. No production state or code is changed.
